# Security

OpenShelf needs ADB debugging switched on, and ADB gives full control of the TV to every computer the TV has approved. Keep the TV on your home network, never forward port 5555 in your router, and decline any "Allow USB debugging?" prompt you did not expect. [docs/safety-and-undo.md](../docs/safety-and-undo.md) has the details.

## Reporting a problem

If you find a security problem in the tool, the home screen, the keeper or the AirPlay patch, use **Report a vulnerability** on the repository's Security tab, so it can be fixed before it is public. Please don't open a public issue for it. Problems in the AirPlay receiver itself belong to [jqssun/android-airplay-server](https://github.com/jqssun/android-airplay-server).
